name: Apache CloudStack Self-Hosted IaaS
free_limit: Free open-source IaaS cloud orchestration platform to provision and manage private/public cloud virtual machines, compute hosts, networking, templates, storage and accounts via an API and web UI.
watch_out: CloudStack software is open source, not a provider-hosted free VPS or pre-funded compute credit. You must provide and operate your own hypervisors/physical compute hosts, networking, storage and associated cloud infrastructure; commercial support is optional and separate.
